title: The Uplift a Member's Coverage Carries on Its Yearly Allowance
content:
The grant of a coverage year's allowance on a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans carries an uplift where the customer holds standing in the Belrose Circle Membership Programme, and which uplift turns on the qualifying spend recorded since the current tier took effect.

Where the customer's membership stands active and the qualifying spend recorded since its tier took effect is at or above the spend that tier must be maintained by, the grant carries the maintained-member uplift, being 1.1 times the figure the steps before it leave. Where the membership stands active and that spend is below the spend the tier must be maintained by, the grant carries the unmaintained-member uplift, being 1.05 times that figure. Where no membership stands active for the customer, the grant carries no uplift at all.

## Where the membership stands

| Membership standing | Qualifying spend recorded since the tier took effect | The uplift the grant carries |
|---|---|---|
| active | at or above the spend the tier must be maintained by | 1.1 times |
| active | below the spend the tier must be maintained by | 1.05 times |
| not active | (not reached) | none |

The spend compared is the qualifying spend recorded since the current tier took effect, not the spend over the whole life of the membership.

## Basis questions

**A member at a tier whose maintenance spend is nothing.** The spend recorded since the tier took effect stands at or above a requirement of nothing, so the grant carries the uplift of 1.1 times.

**A membership that has lapsed or closed.** No membership stands active, so the grant carries no uplift at all.
